title: Scope of Work, Completion and Job Charges Account Schedule — Installation Jobs
content:
This schedule of the contract scope sets, for each installation method of **Installation Jobs**, what the job includes, how the job is completed, how suspected hazards are handled and how job charges are collected and waived.

## Scope and completion

| Installation method | Removal and disposal of the old units included | Security alarm sensors reconnected by Ridgeline | Crew lead and customer walk every opening before the certificate is signed | Signed completion certificate required to complete the job, start warranty coverage and release financing funds | Crew stops work and the branch manager takes over on suspected asbestos or mold |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Insert Pocket Installation | Yes | No | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Full-Frame Installation | Yes | No | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Full-Frame Installation with Exterior Trim Wrap | Yes | No | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Masonry Opening Installation | Yes | No | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Bay and Bow Installation | Yes | No | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Door System Installation | Yes | No | Yes | Yes | Yes |

Where Ridgeline does not reconnect security alarm sensors, the customer's alarm company reconnects them.

## Job charges account

| Installation method | When job charges are collected | Times one fee may be waived |
|---|---|---|
| Insert Pocket Installation | With the contract's final balance | 1 |
| Full-Frame Installation | With the contract's final balance | 1 |
| Full-Frame Installation with Exterior Trim Wrap | With the contract's final balance | 1 |
| Masonry Opening Installation | With the contract's final balance | 1 |
| Bay and Bow Installation | With the contract's final balance | 1 |
| Door System Installation | With the contract's final balance | 1 |

Collection with the contract's final balance means the net job charges are added to the contract's balance due.

## Points of the schedule

- The job charges account holds installation job charges owed by the customer beyond the contract price — site conditions, compliance, reschedule and access fees — net of credits and waivers, in USD.
- A fee may be waived 1 time under every method; a second waiver of the same fee is beyond that limit.
